materialization: After both prediction files and their runtime traces are sealed, the launcher writes the two exact manifest paths to score-jobs.jsonl in this order. No scorer starts before both manifest hashes exist. The --finalize mode runs the unchanged official scorer exactly once per complete arm, writes each score artifact, and terminally settles the two independent one-shot attempts in the same outer-parallel wave.
aggregation_rule: Never shard a dataset for scoring and never average shard-level metrics. Each worker invokes the unchanged official scorer on one complete arm.
